Someone reached out to me explaining how they are an account manager that helps people trade. I was interested. I had some savings I could invest and see how it goes. The minimum investment was 120$ and so I bought some Bitcoin of that worth and registered on their site which they gave me for the trading. Before going any further, I decided to withdraw the money into my existing wallet to see how things happen, but that was not possible. I reach out to the support on the site. They told me the trading had already begun and that until the end of the trade I will not be able to retrieve the money. 
So i start pestering the account manager who says the same thing. Later informs me that i made a profit of 1600$ and that per agreement I was to pay them 10% of the profits. But then once the trade was over, they told me to pay them the money upfront before i could withdraw my profit._x000D_
I refuse. The final profit was of 1800$ and I had to send them and additional 180$. I eventually did because I wanted to just retrieve my money._x000D_
They ask me to download Trust wallet and i protested asking the money to be sent to my current wallet but they refused. I am exhausted, I just want my money, i check trust wallet out and seems trustworthy and so I downloaded and proceeded with the withdrawal. Up until now i have not received the funds. They told me when I protested after the first half hour, to add a wallet and gave me the crypto address, which I did. Over 4000$ is on the wallet. I find it suspicious and i ask whether i can retrieve the money they said yes._x000D_
I try to send the money to my trusted wallet and then find out it is a watch wallet only. I point it out to the so called accounts manager who requested an additional of 300$ to give me the private key to get the funds.
